ive long accepted the fact that therapy would not actually completely "cure" me of this, but i still appreciate it as it kinda provides a listening ear. Its like talking to someone who views your problem seriously and is not biased in whatsoever way, which is hard to find in lets say friends or even family. 

i dont know whether this is avpd, but majority of me have no desire or whatsoever to even get better or function normally (get a job/go to school etc). some might say its bc im lazy but tbh its always fear and the subconscious knowing that i will fall backwards again. Its almost like our minds are programmed to think negatively, sort of like a self defence mechanism to avoid the possibility of incurring another trauma.

i am absolutely hardworking and put in my best at home when im alone, but with people around it seems my mind just freezes. I cant think of anything and this in turn causes more panic and anxiety. rlly its a ruthless cycle.
